column3: in the form of a touchstone
would desire, greedy for all desires
the division of the group is determined
with arms, thighs, necks, bellies cut
with cut arms, thighs, neck, bodies
with horns cut, like a mountain by Indra's might
made the earth free of kshatriyas
banner of the whole class of beings
ocean of qualities sung by the Vedas
in the path of the Vedas
though swallowed by the lord of demons
to the one whose eternal experience is hidden
whose movement of the Self is hidden
being under the control of his devotees
being under the control of his devotees, not
smile that destroys the pride of his devotees
with heart compassionate for his devotees
desiring to fulfil the desired object of his devotees
having descended from his own elephant
banner, thunderbolt, on the petals of his lotus feet
... lotus, goad: wonderful marks on the petals of his lotus feet
written by his own people in the heart in the Self
joy of the pleasure of his own speech
with red lotus feet of his beloved
blind by his own worldly course
with rays of the nectar-water of his own face
for the protection of his own path
imitations of the pastimes of him whose body was taken for the protection of his own path
having departed from his own Vedic path without calamity
for the growth of his own creation
in the form of one's own
with undivided devotion to his own Self and god
the sole refuge of the qualities of his own
because of the eternity of the two
continuous series of unending sorrows ceased
with ever-joyful, loving wife, children, kin
you will soon attain me always
in the Endless, body of eternal happiness and knowledge
freed of maya by experience of eternal Self-happiness, within
of the nature of eternal bliss
whose thirst ceased from ever-experienced own gain
because of ever-steady samadhi, the delusion of qualities turned back
by the constant giver of pain
in the heat of the summer sun
of one wishing to meditate on the Self-maya
sleeping, scratching the itch on the mountain-turning post
to him whose lotus-eyes bloom at the end of sleep
having placed, with heart soft with tear drops
having placed, with heart soft with tears, sprinkled even though devoted to non-duality, at the beginning
to him for whom the delusion of difference is drunk away
loudly confused by intoxication from drinking too much
touched by the Lord's arms fell
they, touched by the Lord's arms, fell
... of yogis firmly controlling breath, mind and senses, in secret
with secret arms, wishing to fight the elephants of the directions
school of fish at rest in water
with minds sunk in him through the eye-holes
for the sake of a wink
should restrain the senses from sense objects by mind
of the elephant-king and crocodile fighting thus
of the elephant-king and crocodile fighting thus, dragging
... lotus feet of you, seeking, the intelligence of other house-blind wells
burst from one, did not become
free from toil of all means
from hell, from the unfortunate, from the ocean of unhappiness
except recounting a part of the most auspicious, excellent multitude of qualities that remove (sin)
with love ceased, though body restrained
with love ceased, though body restrained, to him
though removed from equality and excellence
I shall wander free of ego
without the Self by the Self
seeing, touching, talking, jesting and so on
by the rule of nirukta, the Lord
explained, attained by those devoted to him, by the Self
having restrained breath with undivided mind
of the free of limiting condition
even a particle is to be examined
having sent out the women's apartments
because of being without qualities, no blessings
conquered the elephants of the quarters, Kubera's...
who burnt the three cities, by his grace obtained a position
by the merciless of unconquered selves
to him whose waves of confusion of substance, action, agent are shaken off
broken, banner and golden pot of the intellect
fearless, by himself fire-formed, not hurried
poison came from the ocean churned
mixed with the sound of churning
with stainless groups of stars rising
wonderful marks made by the noose of non-yoga (two)
one who has done good rites
while being completed, rising again and again in the interval
to the ocean of liberation's happiness
one who speaks of dispassion thus
by freedom from enmity, equanimity and peace
(they) call the abode of the Lord
bound by bonds of causes, frightened
in the turning back of Govinda
whose intellect is in dwelling, water, wealth, Self
wrapped by the Vedas, with the glory of a bee
because of ceasing of soulhood, with afflictions destroyed, attaining bliss
sung by those whose thirst has ceased
to him whose view of duality has ceased
ceased enjoyments, in expectation of that
whose confusion of all sense functions has ceased
whose confusion of all sense functions ceased, praised
devoted to the dharma of withdrawal
to the one devoted to the dharma of withdrawal
those on the path of withdrawal
ceased even from killing the wicked
having heard Ajita's talk of unreal
having heard the honoured, little, meaningful
having heard, with tearful eyes wept
